- scripts/security_dependency.py:34-35 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: SECURITY_DEPENDENCY_RE uses (?m) without case-insensitive flag, while SECURITY_DEPENDENCY_LINE_RE uses (?mi). The search/count at line 59 is case-insensitive, but the extraction at line 66 is case-sensitive. A `- depends on: #N` (lowercase) line would match the search, produce a non-empty `findall` result at line 63, but produce zero matches at line 66, triggering "invalid or repeated security dependency" (ValueError).
  WHY: security-audit.sh writes the dependency line in the canonical `- Depends on: #N` format, so this path is not hit in practice. The case-insensitive search exists only as a pre-filter to skip the ai:security label check for issues with no dependency line at all.
- Requirement: "The `claude-fixer-auto-merge` job id is kept but never runs, in case a required check names it." (from changelog.d/6118)

  Evidence of absence: The job exists at review_autofix.yml:1984-1991 with `if: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.skip_reason == 'claude_fixer_auto_merge_retired' }}`. The gate never emits this skip_reason value, so the job will always be skipped. This satisfies the requirement — the job id is retained for consumers with required checks that name it.
